y-m-61-10.title: Singalinganisa umda ongu-3 nexabiso lesixhobo?
y-m-61-10.topic: Imida yemisebenzi: imida yamaqhezu abaphantsi kwawo asondela ku-0, nemilinganiselo engabelwanga
y-m-61-10.goal: Qonda imeko ekufuneka isixhobo sikulandele xa umda weqhezu elinomphantsi osondela ku-0 uyixabiso elimisiweyo, fumana umgca kwisisombululo oxuba ixabiso lomda nexabiso lesixhobo, uze wakhe (a, b) apho ixabiso lomda li-L wena.
y-m-61-10.material: Kwiziqhubekayo a no-b, masithi (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) isondela ku-3 xa x isondela ku-1. (x²+ax+b 'ngu-x isikwere kunye a x kunye b', yaye umphantsi 'ngu-x ukususa 1'.) UYunseo wazama ukufumana a no-b ngolu hlobo.
y-m-61-10.prereq.1: Ixabiso lomda wepolynomial xa x isondela ku-1
y-m-61-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sikaYunseo.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba isigqibo somgca wesi-2 nebinzana lomgca wesi-3 zithetha into enye na.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana kwimeko yokuqala ukuba ibinzana 3 lixabiso lomda wantoni.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.0: Njengoko x isondela ku-1, ixabiso le-(x²+ax+b)/(x−1) lisondela ku-3.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.1: Umphantsi usondela ku-0 kodwa yonke isondela kwixabiso elimisiweyo 3, ngoko isixhobo nasona sisondela ku-0.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.4: Hlola ukuba eli binzana liyahlulwa nge-(x−1) ukufumana a.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 awulunganga. Umgca wesi-2 wathi isixhobo sisondela ku-0, ngoko 1+a+b kufuneka ibe ngu-0. 3 lixabiso lomda weqhezu lonke, hayi ixabiso lesixhobo. Kwimigca yesi-4 nesi-5, isiphumo sokumisela isixhobo sibe ngu-3 libinzana elilingana no-3 kwi-x=1 yaye alihlulwa nge-(x−1).
y-m-61-10.s.s2.prompt: Sifuna ukuhlola isizathu sikaYunseo kumgca wesi-2. Ukuba, njengoko x isondela ku-1, isixhobo sisondela kwixabiso elimisiweyo elingengo-0 (umzekelo, 3) kwaye umphantsi usondela ku-0, kwenzeka ntoni kwixabiso leqhezu?
y-m-61-10.s.s2.hint.0: Misela inani elingasentla libe ngu-3, utshintshe inani elingaphantsi libe ngu-0.1, 0.01, 0.001, uze ubale amaxabiso.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola nokuba kwenzeka ntoni xa inani elingaphantsi lisondela ku-0 lisuka kwicala elinegatifu.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.a: Ixabiso eliphelele liyakhula ngaphandle komda yaye alisondeli kwinani elinye.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.a: Ujonge zombini umphumo wenani elingaphantsi elisondela ku-0 nenyaniso yokuba inani elingasentla alingu-0.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.b: Inani elingaphantsi lisondela ku-0, ngoko iqhezu nalo lisondela ku-0.

y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.c: Lisondela kwixabiso lenani elingasentla, ngu-3, njengoko linjalo. Inani elingaphantsi alichaphazeli ixabiso.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.c: Uphoswe ngumphumo wokuba umahluli uba mncinci. Bala ixabiso leqhezu ngqo.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.d: Inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi lihamba kwicala elinye, ngoko lisondela ku-1.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.d: Inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi lihamba ngokwahlukileyo ngobukhulu. Bala ngqo ngamaxabiso ambalwa.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.explain: Ukuba inani elingasentla lisondele ku-3 yaye inani elingaphantsi lincipha libe ngu-0.1, 0.01, 0.001, ixabiso likhula lisondele ku-30, 300, 3000. Alisondeli kwinani elinye. Ngoko ukuze ixabiso lomda libe lixabiso elimiselweyo, inani elingasentla kufuneka nalo lisondele ku-0.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.prompt: Qala umisele ixabiso lomda L, uze ufumane iinani eziphelele a no-b ezinika eli xabiso lomda. Faka ezintathu ezahlukeneyo (a, b, L), ezinee-L ezahlukeneyo, ukuze umda we-(x²+ax+b)/(x−1) xa i-x isondela ku-1 ube yi-L (inani eliphelele elinoku-1≤L≤5).
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-a ne-b obenza inani elingasentla libe ngu-0 ku-x=1.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.1: Faka olo budlelwane kwinani elingasentla, khupha u-(x−1) uze uwuchithe, uze ujonge ukuba ixabiso lomda libhalwa njani ngokwe-a.

y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c1: I-a, b, L kufuneka zibe ziinani eziphelele, yaye i-L kufuneka ibe phakathi kwe-1 kunye ne-5 kubandakanywa.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c2: Inani elingasentla lingu-0 ku-x=1, ngoko lilutyekelo olunokuchithwa.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Inani elingasentla alingu-0 ku-x=1. Inani elingasentla kufuneka libe ngu-0 ukuze kuphume ixabiso elimiselweyo.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c3: Ixabiso lomda emva kokuchitha, a+2, lilingana ne-L.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Ixabiso lomda alinguye i-L. Bhala inani elingasentla njengemveliso ye-(x−1) nenye intetho ethe tye, chitha, uze ufumane ixabiso lomda.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.explain: Ukuba 1+a+b=0, ke b=−1−a kwaye x²+ax−1−a=(x−1)(x+1+a). Ukuchitha kunika x+1+a, yaye umda xa i-x isondela ku-1 yi-a+2. Ngoko L=a+2 kunye no-b=−1−a, yaye i-(a, b) enye imiselwe kwi-L nganye.
